text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The two selected Legacy Umamusume<n>and
your Trainee Umamusume have an<n>affinity
level determined by their<n>relationship.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's said that if they share a good<n>affinity,
it becomes a little more likely<n>for
something nice to happen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This might be good to remember when<n>
you're making arrangements in the<n>
future. ♪
